items.text: EXPECTED TO PLAY: Puka Nacua, Zay Flowers, Ladd McConkey, Tyjae Spears. GTD/OPTIMISTIC: Mike Evans. NOT EXPECTED: Jalen Coker, Terry McLaurin, Keenan Allen. STARTING: Tyson Bagent.
items.why: Weekend reports summary for key fantasy players.
items.implication: Lock in expected; monitor Evans closely pregame.

items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin, dealing with a hamstring injury, officially is inactive today in London vs. the Colts.
items.why: Hamstring suffered late in practice week; official inactive.
items.implication: Sit; targets redistribute to other WAS pass-catchers.

items.text: Sources: Rams do not intend to limit Puka Nacua’s workload today vs. the Eagles.
items.why: Schefter sources confirm no workload restriction on return from hip/groin.
items.implication: Full-ish role expected; start confidently in all formats.
items.opportunity: High snap/route share vs depleted Eagles secondary.

items.text: Only small dock on Puka Nacua (groin) now; Rams do not intend to limit workload per Schefter. Tinier dock on Zay Flowers; bigger on Ladd McConkey and Mike Evans.
items.why: Updated projections post-Schefter no-limit report and practice trends.
items.implication: Nacua/Flowers closer to full projection; caution Evans/McConkey.

items.text: Baker Mayfield dislocated thumb expected to sideline 3-6 weeks depending on grip recovery. Undrafted Jalon Daniels first rookie QB start this season.
items.implication: TB offense downgrade; stream WRs carefully.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans practiced late week despite ribs and will do his best to play; team optimistic though fractured ribs suck.
items.implication: Monitor inactive; Kittle upside if limited/out.

items.text: Panthers WR Jalen Coker, Q with quad, is unlikely to play Sunday night vs Lions.
items.implication: Boost to other CAR WRs/TEs if confirmed.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is likely to play today after foot injury all week; not as serious as recent rib issue.
items.why: Source; foot less concerning than prior rib.
items.implication: Probable starter but bigger projection dock per Levitan.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers, limited this week with hamstring, is expected to play today; was questionable.
items.why: Source confirms expected despite limited practice.
items.implication: Start; no hard pitch count expected.

items.text: Eagles situation getting worse. Without three of most important players vs Rams: DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Zack Baun.
items.implication: PHI offense downgraded; Hurts/others less efficient.

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins (hamstring) return. DvP: Cowboys inflate opposing WR scoring 7.3% (most in NFL). Texans implied 7th-most points.
items.opportunity: High target share vs soft secondary.

items.text: The moment Jordan Addison truthers have been waiting for. Home vs borderline NFL secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
items.why: Jefferson out opens massive target opportunity.
items.opportunity: WR1 target share home vs weak secondary.

items.text: Parlay: Garrett Wilson (no AD Mitchell) as underdog, Michael Wilson 7+ targets vs NYG, Addison without Jefferson vs MIA.
items.why: Injury-driven volume spikes in favorable spots.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE: 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game; full workhorse with Dowdle out.
items.why: Elite utilization + soft run D matchup.

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% career TS with Penix, 43.5% last week (9-194); NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Massive target share with Penix + favorable WR TD matchup.

items.text: LOVE Garrett Wilson @ CHI: AD Mitchell likely out again; 36% TS last time Mitchell out; CHI allows 14+ YPR.
items.why: Elevated target share without Mitchell + soft coverage.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton @ SEA: low utilization (3.5% TS, 25% routes, 42% snaps W3); SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
items.why: Poor role + elite run defense matchup.

items.text: HATE Emeka Egbuka vs GB: Jalon Daniels first start, only 1 RZ target all year, TB low implied total.
items.why: QB downgrade + limited RZ role + poor game script.
